fields.Name: T323 - New Routine Required Field Validation Block
fields.Description: Exercises NewRoutine.validate() surfacing the ValidationErrors alert and blocking Save — a bespoke client-side validation path distinct from the generated entity form's required-field enforcement.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Routines app, click 'New Routine' to open the editor (wait 10-30s for it to load). Without filling in the Name and without selecting an agent, click the primary 'Create Routine' button at the bottom. Success is that the save is BLOCKED and a validation error area appears at the top listing the missing requirements — for example 'Name is required.' and a message to select the agent this routine should run. The editor must stay open (not navigate back to the list). You do NOT need to then fix and save.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Create Routine' with an empty Name and no agent selected does NOT create a routine or leave the editor
A validation error message is shown citing at least the missing name and/or missing agent
No error messages beyond the expected validation alert, and no blank screens or crash pages
